name: Google Earth Basemap
author: NakshaTech
description:
Universal VTK-native basemap plugin for NakshaAI. Two free, no-key providers are built in - Esri World Imagery (satellite) and OpenStreetMap (street/roadmap) - matching the reference Urban Surve platform project. Google Satellite/Roadmap/Terrain remain optional when the user provides a Google Maps Platform API key. Basemap tiles auto-refresh on every camera pan/zoom (including programmatic zoom performed by the host app).
- External ZIP install with no core app edits
- Esri World Imagery satellite works without an API key
- OpenStreetMap street/roadmap works without an API key
- Auto-refresh tiles on zoom in/out and pan (camera ModifiedEvent observer)
- Optional official Google Map Tiles API support
- 2D Top/Plan View integration
- Project CRS reprojection with pyproj, reading the host's authoritative canvas CRS (gui.crs_manager) when available
- 1.1.7: removed the EPSG:3857 fallback used while real project data has an unresolved CRS (tiles now refuse to render misaligned rather than guessing); added on_canvas_crs_changed() so the host's canvas-CRS notification reaches this plugin directly; past a location's real Esri imagery resolution, the deepest available tile now stays on screen (stretched) instead of showing Esri's own "Map data not yet available" placeholder graphic
- 1.1.8: tiles now load center-out instead of scanline order so the view fills in steadily instead of popping in at random spots; Esri requests are split across its two mirror hostnames for roughly double effective download concurrency
- 1.1.14: ribbon UI kept as the original QFrame panel + plain-text Basemap/Refresh/Go To/Settings buttons (no icons, no RibbonSection) - a v1.1.9/1.1.10 attempt at icon-based styling stretched the ribbon bar and was reverted; runs on the v1.1.8 backend (center-out tile loading, Esri mirror-host concurrency, overzoom placeholder rejection, CRS hooks); provider dropdown labels cleaned to "Esri World Imagery (Free)" / "OpenStreetMap (Free)" / "Google Satellite" / "Google Roadmap" / "Google Terrain" (no "API key" wording)
- 1.1.16: SNT-first priority rule (SNT CRS overrides canvas CRS; detaching SNT restores point cloud CRS); resilient DGN SpatialRef and multi-PRJ fallback resolution; Canadian and polar domain bounds protection
- Async Qt network requests with free-provider host fallback
- VTK-native JPEG/PNG tile decoding
- Provider attribution
- Clean enable/disable/reinstall/uninstall lifecycle
- 1.1.17: Extreme zoom-out full canvas coverage & amoeba elimination (world-extent coordinate clamping for Web Mercator; robust sample-grid projection bounding; out-of-domain singularity tile rejection)
- 1.1.18: Fixed SNT/DXF/GIS data occasionally rendering behind the basemap - the Z-separation used to keep the basemap under real data was a fixed tiny epsilon that depth-buffer precision could swallow at real-world coordinate magnitudes; now scales with camera view distance like the existing placeholder-tile separation
- 1.1.19: basemap tiles are routed through the host render pipeline (gui.scene_render_pipeline) so they stay on the raster layer beneath LiDAR/vector data; calls are now guarded with a fallback to the plain renderer, so the plugin still installs and runs on older app builds without that module
